name: pig-lightning-pigman
comment: WP-4.6. EntityPig.onStruckByLightning (EntityPig.java:62-69): a pig (id 0) at (0.5, 61, 0.5) on the stone platform, a cow (id 1) at (2.5, 61, 0.5) and a second pig (id 2) at (8.5, 61, 0.5), out of the bolt's reach. t=3 an EntityLightningBolt (harness kind LightningBolt, id 3) at the first pig. Its first update (EntityLightningBolt.java:62-72) calls onStruckByLightning on every entity within 3 blocks: the pig becomes a new EntityPigZombie (id 4: its constructor's Math.random() draws, setLocationAndAngles at the pig's position and angles, entityJoinedWorld, rand seeded at join) and dies without fire damage; the cow takes Entity.onStruckByLightning (5 fire damage, fire). The pigman, immune to fire, is struck again while lightningState >= 0. Difficulty 1 so that EntityMob.onUpdate does not remove the pigman at once (difficultySetting 0 kills monsters, EntityMob.java:22-24); no player, mob_spawning none, so nothing spawns; the bolt's constructor places no fire below difficulty 2. rng_state, entity_state every tick, the blocks around the strike.
